# Company logos

Original company logos used in the repository README. The files retain their original colors and proportions.

| File | Official source |
| --- | --- |
| `espressif.svg` | [Espressif website logo](https://www.espressif.com/sites/all/themes/espressif/logo-black.svg); [logo guidelines](https://www.espressif.com/en/about-espressif/logo-guidelines) |
| `m5stack.svg` | `M5Stack Logo/Horizontal Version/SVG/Color logo.svg` from the [official Brand Kit](https://static-cdn.m5stack.com/resource/public/assets/M5Stack%20Logo.zip); [brand guidelines](https://m5stack.com/brand-guidelines) |
| `waveshare.png` | [Waveshare website logo](https://www.waveshare.com/media/eternal/venedor/default/logo.png) |
| `guition.webp` | Header logo on the [Guition model selection page](https://www.guition.com/model-selection) |
